name: hire-bot
tagline: Handles the paperwork half of hiring, from candidate notes to offer letter
description: It sits across your applicant tracking system, LinkedIn and your inbox, gathering what has already been said about a candidate in scattered conversations. From that context it will put together a first draft of a contractor agreement or a formal offer, leaving every hiring decision itself to you.
author: xsubwayratx
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
